Don't wait — this Barefoot Dreams blanket is still 53% off for Amazon Prime Big Deal Days

Prep for winter weather with this luxuriously soft Barefoot Dreams throw blanket — it has a spot on Oprah's Favorite Things and it's more than half off for Prime Day.

This blanket is perfect for cuddling up during the fall and winter. (iStock)

Amazon’s October Prime Day might end tonight, but there are still plenty of amazing deals worth shopping — including this undeniably soft Barefoot Dreams blanket. It’s the ultimate cold weather essential and makes a useful gift, so you can get ahead of holiday shopping with it. Right now, it's under $100.

READ MORE: October Prime Day ends today: Get 50% off a Shark vacuum, AirPods for $70 off and more

Original price: $158

Stay warm now that cooler weather is here to stay. (Amazon)

The iconic Barefoot Dreams CozyChic throw blanket feels luxuriously soft, so much so that it’s earned a spot on Oprah’s Favorite Things list. Plus, it’s super easy to clean in the washing machine.

Several colors are 53% off for October Prime Day, bringing the fan-favorite blanket to just $75, including the rich crimson color, which is ideal for the holiday season. Plus, its 54-by-72-inch size is perfect for cuddling up for a holiday movie marathon.

The blanket has maintained a 4.7-star rating at full price, but now that it’s more than 50% off, it’s even more of a worthwhile deal.

READ MORE: Prime Big Deal Days: 12 Amazon sales to kick off holiday shopping

Reviewers love the blanket’s size, weight and extreme softness, especially for winter evenings.

"It's incredibly soft, plush, and cozy, making it perfect for snuggling up on the couch or relaxing at the end of the day," one reviewer wrote.

"Bought this for myself with my birthday gift card and I don’t regret it one bit," another wrote. "My three boys asked me to add one for each of them to their Christmas lists!"

This blanket is even better after every wash. According to one reviewer: "It is so soft and washes great! It’s like wrapping myself in total comfort."

READ MORE: October Prime Day home deals: A $150 Ninja air fryer, 50% off Roomba vacuums and more

The high price tag of this blanket may deter shoppers — another reason to buy now while it comes in at less than $100. A few reviewers report shedding, so make sure to follow the manufacturer’s care instructions.
